description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of reasoning steps and the Pass@1 rate for two language models. The x-axis is labeled “Num. of Reasoning Steps” with a linear scale ranging from 5 to 40, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled “Pass@1 Rate (%)” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 20.  A blue line with circular markers represents GPT-4o, starting at the coordinate (5, 19.4) and increasing to (40, 83.9). The line shows a relatively steady increase between 5 and 10, reaching a value of 38.7 at x=10, then continues to rise to a value of 77.4 at x = 20. A light purple line with cross markers represents Claude-3.5-Sonnet, starting at the coordinate (5, 6.5) and increasing to (40, 89.2). This line increases from 6.5 at x=5 to 32.3 at x=10, then rises to 77.4 at x=20, and finally to 89.2 at x=40.
